confidence_notes: Food estimates use [Numbeo's London prices](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/London). Cocktail and wine estimates use broad [local bar ranges](https://www.london-escape.com/guides/london-nightlife-pubs/) and are about twice and 1.1 times the beer price, respectively. July accommodation is a general-knowledge estimate sensitive to location and demand. USD estimates use current exchange rates.
comparable_city_reasoning: London-specific price data and general knowledge of London as a high-demand European capital; no comparable city was needed.
